frame: native sheet pixels. x: shift from the centre line (0 = canvas centred on it). y: top of the slot canvas, measured from the top of the reference figure canvas after enlarging it by 1/figure_scale.

sword.note: held by the grip: turned 180 degrees (the sheet draws the sword point-down) and scaled 1.2x; 'tilt' turns it further around the hand, clockwise from straight up (0 = up, 90 = out to the side, 180 = down)
